current_evidence: The authority's Validation Checklist page still links this PDF as 'a copy of the Local Validation Checklist' and says the Chief Executive approved it on 25 January 2021, that a review on 21 September 2023 proposed no changes, and that national BNG was added to the Full Planning checklist in March 2025; no newer local list was found (cover of PDF says December 2020).

issues.detail: List date 2021-01-01 is the upload-month folder in the URL. The cover says 'December 2020' and the planning page says the Chief Executive approved the list on 25 January 2021. It was then reviewed on 21 September 2023 with no changes, so 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' overstates the age. Note that the page says the 2023 review is valid for two years, so that period lapsed in September 2025 and a fresh review is due.
issues.evidence: Validation Checklist page: 'The Chief Executive approved the updated Local Validation Checklist on 25 January 2021'; 'Updated September 2023 ... reviewed on 21 September 2023 ... no changes proposed'

issues.detail: All three Householder rows (Contaminated Land, Drainage Strategy/SuDS, Foul Sewage/Utilities) are for items the source explicitly excludes from householder applications. Grokbot's note 'Application type named in requirement text' misread the exclusion as an inclusion.
issues.evidence: LOCAL 14: 'All applications where land contamination can reasonably be expected to be found (nonhouseholder)'; LOCAL 13: 'For any development (other than householder extensions)...'

issues.detail: The authority's own Householder Planning Application Checklist (linked from the same validation page) lists local requirements Grokbot did not capture for Householder: Site Plan, Existing and Proposed Elevations, and Floor Plans ('required in most cases'); Site Sections (where they aid understanding of layout); Roof Plans (alteration to an existing roof); Biodiversity Survey (demolition of a building, roof alteration, or removal of trees or vegetation); Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zones 2 and 3); Heritage Statement (affecting designated or non-designated heritage assets); Landscaping Plan (landscaping alterations); Lighting Assessment (external lighting); Parking Provision (loss of parking); Tree Survey (material impact on trees).
issues.evidence: Householder Planning Application Checklist page, items 4-15 labelled 'Local'

issues.detail: Advertisement consent is shown as '(none)', but LOCAL 05 'Advertisement Consent Requirements' applies to all advertisement consent applications, and the Heritage Statement (LOC15) applies to advertisement consent where heritage is a statutory consideration. Grokbot instead put an 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' row under Full planning, using the fragment 'hours of illumination and any measures such as motion sensors.' as its trigger.
issues.evidence: LOCAL 05 Advertisement Consent Requirements - When required? All applications for advertisement consent

issues.detail: Numbered local items that are missing or not recorded as requirements: LOCAL 29 Utilities Assessment (new buildings or changes of use of existing buildings), which is only half-covered by a householder 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' row that quotes the foul drainage trigger; LOCAL 32 Window Section Plans (window replacement or alteration affecting heritage assets), captured only as a drawing-scale note in tab_items; LOCAL 02 Floor Plans (folded into the elevations row); the separate Odour Assessment for livestock buildings shown on the Full Planning checklist; and the Heritage Statement for full and householder applications (Grokbot lists it only under Listed building consent, although LOC15 covers 'any planning or listed building applications' affecting a heritage asset or its setting).
issues.evidence: PDF items LOCAL 29, LOCAL 32, LOCAL 02, LOC15; Full Planning Permission Checklist items 31, 34

issues.detail: About 20 Full planning rows are flagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. Air Quality, Tree Survey, Lighting, Noise, Parking, LVIA, Structural Survey). Meanwhile Outline, Reserved matters, LDC, s73, NMA, Discharge of conditions, Works to trees and Prior approval all show '(none)'. The authority publishes a separate checklist for each of these 18 application types (e.g. Outline all/some matters reserved, Reserved Matters, Removal/Variation of Condition, Tree Works, Prior Notification agricultural/demolition/telecoms), and Grokbot did not read them. For example, LOCAL 28 states extra tree information is needed where trees are under a TPO or in a Conservation Area, which is relevant to tree works, and Listed Building Consent requires a Design and Access Statement under NATIONAL 05.
issues.evidence: Validation Checklist page 'Validation Checklists' section listing 18 per-application-type checklists

issues.detail: Several triggers are wrong or cut off. Environmental Statement quotes Coal Mining Risk Assessment text ('Tree Works EIA Scoping Opinions In terms of the nature of the development, whether a Coal Mining Risk Assessment is required...'), whereas LOCAL 11 requires it for EIA development under the 2017 Regulations. Flood Risk Assessment stops at 'Development within Flood Zones 2 & 3:' and omits sites of 1ha or more and changes of use to a more vulnerable class. Design and Access Statement stops after 'Applications for major development' and omits 1+ dwellings or 100sqm+ buildings in a Conservation Area or World Heritage Site, and listed building consent. Coal Mining Risk Assessment omits the exemptions (householder, advertisements, LDCs, prior notifications, etc.) and the Referral Area discretion. Affordable Housing omits the named-settlements limb. Ventilation/Extraction is truncated mid-word ('or use vol'). 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is a fragment from the site plan description ('public highway, visibility splays, landscaping, car parking...'), not its own requirement. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' quotes the Structural Survey ('includes a schedule of works necessary to carry out the conversion'), so it is not a listed-building requirement.
issues.evidence: PDF LOCAL 11, LOC12, NATIONAL 05, LOCAL 09, LOCAL 06, LOCAL 30, LOCAL 23

issues.detail: The 'Design Code / Masterplan / Parameter plans' row is not a requirement in this list. Its excerpt is the reference-list and 'why is this required' text for the Lighting Assessment (Dark Sky Park Exterior Lighting Masterplan, BAA Campaign for Dark Skies). The tab item 'Any hard copy Certificate ... must be signed by hand' is submission-process text rather than a local requirement.
issues.evidence: LOCAL 17 Lighting Assessment references: 'Northumberland Dark Sky Park Exterior Lighting Masterplan (in particular page 40)'

issues.detail: Since March 2025 the Full Planning Permission checklist includes Biodiversity Net Gain (national, linked 'NAT06 Biodiversity Net Gain' document). Grokbot did not record this, and did not note that the authority says local BNG documents are 'still under review'.
issues.evidence: Validation Checklist page: 'Updated March 2025: National Biodiversity Net Gain requirements were added to the Full Planning Application checklist'

summary: Grokbot's link is still the authority's current local list (approved 25 Jan 2021, reviewed with no changes 21 Sep 2023). The application-type mapping is badly wrong: householder rows list items that explicitly exclude householders, the authority's 18 per-type checklists were not used, so Householder, Advertisement and other types miss their local requirements, and several triggers are cut off or taken from the wrong item.
